biggest_catch: Dosh sunset the app on February 28, 2025 — card-linked cash back is gone, and any remaining balances after Feb 23, 2025 were forfeited.
catches: Dosh announced the sunset by email: app officially sunset Feb 28, 2025; last qualifying transaction Jan 16, 2025 (frequentmiler.com).
The withdrawal limit was lowered to $0.01 for the wind-down; any cash back balance remaining after Feb 23, 2025 was forfeited.
Cardlytics (which acquired Dosh in 2021) continues the underlying tech through bank rewards programs — but the Dosh consumer app is dead.
Any 'Dosh' app in app stores now is not the original program.

c1.evidence: Dosh is defunct: the company sent a sunset email — app officially sunset Feb 28, 2025, last qualifying transaction Jan 16, 2025 (frequentmiler.com); TripsWithTykes editor's note (Mar 27, 2025): 'Sadly, Dosh permanently shut down its app and operations earlier this year.'

notes: Death evidence: frequentmiler.com quotes Dosh's own sunset email: 'The Dosh app will officially sunset on February 28, 2025 with the last day to make a qualifying transaction on January 16, 2025... any remaining cash back balances after [Feb 23, 2025] will be forfeited.' TripsWithTykes editor's note (Mar 27, 2025): 'Sadly, Dosh permanently shut down its app and operations earlier this year.' Note: the '~2021 closure' hypothesis was wrong — Cardlytics acquired Dosh in 2021 and the app ran until 2025.
